vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/StartButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Start adds a level select (a child of Main named LevelSelect, with a button Box/Grid/Level<N>Button per level, open once the level before it is solved, and Box/BackButton back to the menu) and choosing a level adds the game scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game, with its level in the property level; pause: Escape or the button HUD/PauseButton of the game shows its PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton) and pauses the tree, ResumeButton hides it and resumes; levels 4 to 6 in data/levels.json, each solvable in exactly its par; a data.json for the kit's data runner; and a save of the solved levels and their fewest moves by a SaveStore class (scripts/SaveStore.cs: new SaveStore(path) on a file path, Read() returning a SaveData whose Solved is a Dictionary<string, int> from level ids, as text, to moves, and Write(data) returning true once written) in user://save.json
